You are the Team Leader. The project DAG already exists. Do NOT create projects or tasks beyond it; do NOT replan. Execute strictly in dependency order, one delegation at a time.

1. projectflow(ready_nodes) projectId "elemiso-pr2-gate" -> expect pr2-review-1.
2. taskflow(delegate_task) projectId "elemiso-pr2-gate" taskId "pr2-review-1" roomId "room:!RErK7WVs9iUeaszwho:elemiso-matrix:6167" spec = SPEC A below, passed EXACTLY character-for-character (do not summarize).
3. Wait for the Reviewer: watch the team room reply and use taskflow(check_task) taskId "pr2-review-1". On acceptance (effective result) mark that plan line [x] in plan.md.
4. HUMAN SECURITY GATE (mandatory): if the Reviewer result indicates a HIGH-severity confirmed finding or HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: YES - do NOT delegate pr2-fix-1. Message ME in THIS DM with the finding summary (severity, CWE, affected lines, repro) and WAIT. Continue only after my explicit approval message here. If no high risk is confirmed, also report here and wait for my confirmation before continuing.
5. After my approval: delegate pr2-fix-1 (SPEC B, same EXACT rules), check_task, accept, mark [x]; then delegate pr2-verify-1 (SPEC C), check_task, accept, mark [x].
6. If pr2-verify-1 VERDICT=FAIL: re-delegate pr2-fix-1 ONCE (attempt=2) including the verifier failure output in the spec; a second FAIL -> stop, mark blocked, escalate here. Do not fabricate a rework that did not happen.
7. Final: message ME in THIS DM: final disposition (FIX_VERIFIED / GATE_WAITING / BLOCKED), each task status, and the patch sha256. Only mark the project completed if all three tasks were accepted.
Budget discipline: no redundant tool calls; no re-delegation without a real FAIL result; report BLOCKED instead of improvising.

=== SPEC A (pr2-review-1 -> @reviewer) ===
pr2-review-1 / run-elem-fastapi-pr2-20260916-01 - Reviewer independent security review.
1) First run taskflow(ack_task) with taskId "pr2-review-1".
2) Read ~/task/PR-METADATA.md and ~/task/INSTRUCTIONS.md in your workspace and execute them: clone the repo, checkout head SHA 1dedf5e1992c950557064d8f4fb9039d1523deb3 (verify git rev-parse HEAD), review the added backend/src/interfaces/api/v1/demo_high_risk.py and the added test file (git diff 4cd5bf0..HEAD --stat to confirm scope = 2 files, +122/-0), run the pre-fix reproduction test and record its real output. Use /opt/venv/standard/bin/python (fastapi/httpx/pytest preinstalled); plain `python` lacks them.
3) Findings must cover: user-controlled parameter (name) escaping the base directory (../ sequences); arbitrary file read outside the base directory; affected file/function/lines; severity + CWE id; one reproducible command; the real pre-fix output summary.
4) Submit taskflow(submit_task) taskId "pr2-review-1" result status="SUCCESS" (or "BLOCKED" if a step truly cannot run) and a summary containing: STATUS: FINDING_CONFIRMED or NOT_CONFIRMED; SEVERITY: <level>; HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: YES or NO; deliverables = key findings; notes = repro command + output summary.
5) Reply in THIS team room mentioning @leader: run_id, role=Reviewer, head SHA first 8 chars, findings; last line exactly: TASK_COMPLETED: run-elem-fastapi-pr2-20260916-01-review
Constraints: do NOT modify any repository file; do NOT include patch/fix code; zero GitHub writes; work only in your own workspace.

=== SPEC B (pr2-fix-1 -> @fixer) ===
pr2-fix-1 / run-elem-fastapi-pr2-20260916-01 - Fixer minimal fix, local patch only (attempt=1).
1) taskflow(ack_task) taskId "pr2-fix-1".
2) Read ~/task/PR-METADATA.md and ~/task/INSTRUCTIONS.md; clone + checkout head SHA 1dedf5e1992c950557064d8f4fb9039d1523deb3 (verify). Base the fix on the Reviewer finding summary posted in this room by @leader (expected: path traversal in demo_download of backend/src/interfaces/api/v1/demo_high_risk.py). Use /opt/venv/standard/bin/python (fastapi/httpx/pytest preinstalled); plain `python` lacks them.
3) Modify ONLY backend/src/interfaces/api/v1/demo_high_risk.py. Acceptance behavior: (a) names containing ../ or equivalent traversal sequences are rejected (HTTP 404 or 400) and no content outside the base directory is ever returned; (b) legitimate files inside the base directory still return 200 with content; (c) missing files return 404.
4) Self-check: python -m py_compile passes. Generate patch: git diff --no-color -- backend/src/interfaces/api/v1/demo_high_risk.py > ~/shared/tasks/pr2-fix-1/attempt-1.diff (mkdir -p first); compute sha256sum of the diff.
5) taskflow(submit_task) taskId "pr2-fix-1" result status="SUCCESS", summary contains FIX_APPLIED + SELF_CHECK_PASSED, notes = [patch sha256, normalization method, boundary check method, error strategy].
6) Reply in THIS team room mentioning @leader: FULL diff in a triple-backtick diff block + patch sha256 + the three explanations; last line exactly: TASK_COMPLETED: run-elem-fastapi-pr2-20260916-01-fix attempt=1
Constraints: only that one file; do NOT modify any test file (backend/tests/unit/test_demo_high_risk_path_traversal.py is frozen); zero GitHub writes; submit when done without waiting for reminders.

=== SPEC C (pr2-verify-1 -> @verifier) ===
pr2-verify-1 / run-elem-fastapi-pr2-20260916-01 - Verifier independent clean-workspace verification (attempt=1).
1) taskflow(ack_task) taskId "pr2-verify-1".
2) Read ~/task/PR-METADATA.md and ~/task/INSTRUCTIONS.md. In a FRESH directory (not used by other roles) clone + checkout head SHA 1dedf5e1992c950557064d8f4fb9039d1523deb3 (verify). Trust only your own command outputs. Use /opt/venv/standard/bin/python (fastapi/httpx/pytest preinstalled); plain `python` lacks them.
3) Pre-fix reproduction: run python -m pytest backend/tests/unit/test_demo_high_risk_path_traversal.py -q, record real output (expected: 2 passed = vulnerability present).
4) Take the Fixer latest diff block in this room (attempt=1), save as attempt-1.diff, verify sha256 equals the value the Fixer posted, then git apply --check && git apply. If apply fails, that is a real result: VERDICT=FAIL.
5) Behavior probes (fastapi TestClient or a small script OUTSIDE the repo): (a) traversal name=../outside-secret.txt must be rejected 404/400 with NO file content leaked; (b) a legitimate file inside the base directory returns 200 + content; (c) a missing name returns 404. Record each command, status code, exit code, output.
6) Regression semantics: the frozen repo test asserts the PRE-fix vulnerable behavior; after applying the patch those 2 tests are EXPECTED to FAIL (assertions inverted). That is not a regression and must not cause rejection. Record the real rerun output.
7) taskflow(submit_task) taskId "pr2-verify-1" result status="SUCCESS" (VERDICT=PASS) or "REVISION_NEEDED" (VERDICT=FAIL) or "BLOCKED"; summary contains VERDICT=PASS or VERDICT=FAIL, patch_sha256=<same value as Fixer>, head_sha=1dedf5e1.
8) Reply in THIS team room mentioning @leader: pre/post probe outputs, pytest outputs, VERDICT; last line exactly: TASK_COMPLETED: run-elem-fastapi-pr2-20260916-01-verify attempt=1
Constraints: do NOT fix the patch yourself; do NOT modify repo tests; zero GitHub writes.
